title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Hit List
desc: Vijay's life turns into a living hell when a mysterious masked figure kidnaps his family.

title: Devil
desc: Hema and Roshan encounter each other during a sudden mishap. Eventually, the narrative examines the prior matrimony of Alex and Hema which collapses because of Alex's infidelity with Sophia.

title: Aadhavan
desc: Dr Kulkarni hires Aadhavan, a sharpshooter, to kill magistrate Subramaniam who is determined to reveal the list of culprits involved in organ trafficking cases.

title: Andhaghaaram
desc: The lives of a blind librarian, dispirited cricketer and desolate psychiatrist seek retribution as their lives coincide under unsettling circumstances.
